meta_description: Electric Works Mcr delivers trusted electrical services across Manchester. NICEIC-registered, fully insured, free quotes, and fast response. Call us today.
hero_subhead: Electrical faults, installations, and upgrades handled fast by fully qualified local electricians you can trust.
services_subhead: From consumer unit upgrades and full rewires to EV charger installation and fault finding, we cover every electrical need for homes and businesses.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Outdated fuse boards are a safety risk and can invalidate home insurance. We replace old units with modern, fully compliant consumer units to keep your property safe and up to current regulations.

services.title: Full & Partial Rewires
services.desc: Whether your property needs a complete rewire or targeted work on ageing circuits, we carry out all rewiring neatly and with minimal disruption to your home or business.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Tripping circuits, dead sockets, or flickering lights can indicate a serious underlying fault. Our electricians diagnose problems quickly and fix them right first time.

services.title: EV Charger Installation
services.desc: We supply and install OZEV-approved home EV charging points, ensuring fast, safe charging for your electric vehicle with a neat, weatherproof finish.

services.title: Lighting Installation
services.desc: From LED downlight upgrades and external security lighting to full design-and-fit lighting schemes, we transform how your home or commercial space looks and feels.

services.title: Electrical Testing & Inspection
services.desc: EICR certificates issued for landlords, home buyers, and businesses. We carry out thorough inspection and testing to confirm your installation meets current BS 7671 standards.

about_pullquote: We do the job properly — every time, for every customer.
about_para_1: Electric Works Mcr was founded to bring honest, high-quality electrical work to homeowners and businesses across Manchester. Based in Old Trafford, we've built our reputation street by street across the city, completing everything from small repairs to large commercial installations. All our electricians are fully qualified and our work is carried out to the latest IET Wiring Regulations.
about_para_2: What keeps our customers coming back is straightforward: we turn up when we say we will, we price fairly, and we never cut corners. Every job — no matter how small — is treated with the same care and attention, and we always leave the work area clean and tidy. That's why the vast majority of our work comes through personal recommendations.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. Came out the same day to sort a tripping circuit, explained exactly what the issue was, and had it fixed within the hour. Very reasonably priced too. Will definitely be using Electric Works Mcr again.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Had a full consumer unit upgrade carried out and couldn't be happier. The lads were punctual, tidy, and professional throughout. Everything was left spotless and I received my certificate promptly. Highly recommend to anyone in Manchester needing an electrician.
reviews.author: Priya S.

reviews.text: Really impressed with the quality of work on my EV charger installation. Turned up on time, completed the job efficiently, and walked me through how everything works. Great communication from booking to completion. Top-notch local business.
reviews.author: Mark H.
